summary: Migration: make queries.user_id/session_id nullable, add guest columns (guest_ip, ip_name, guest_token_hash)
description: Must land BEFORE the guest query path. New migration migrations/016_guest_queries.sql: ALTER TABLE queries ALTER COLUMN user_id DROP NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN session_id DROP NOT NULL (015 already dropped model_used/tier_used NOT NULL for forked rows — same spirit). ADD COLUMN guest_ip TEXT, ADD COLUMN ip_name TEXT, ADD COLUMN guest_token_hash TEXT (all NULL for authed rows). tier_used carries 'guest' for guest rows so existing pro/free tier aggregates exclude them by default. Add a partial index on (guest_token_hash) WHERE user_id IS NULL for the conversion lookup, and on (created_at) WHERE user_id IS NULL for the guest list + purge. Document in the migration header that a NULL user_id row is a not-yet-converted guest query.

resolution.note: migrations/016_guest_queries.sql: DROP NOT NULL on user_id/session_id, add guest columns, partial indexes for conversion lookup + guest-pending scan
